behavior.consent: Owner/admin exact company, mailbox, policy and duration, explicit consent, current membership required, 7/30/90 days, revocable; no automatic activation.
behavior.principal: Distinct worker identity us-support-intake-v1 with delegation revision and run lease; no invented Auth token or device.
behavior.authority: Fresh coherent durable SQL snapshot plus pure catalog validation; no authority reused across async boundaries; private vault read joined to current admission.
behavior.discovery: Read-only fixed-origin Infomaniak adapter, bounded head refresh and offset backfill, durable references/page proof/cursor saved atomically before processing; offset pagination is not exhaustive-delivery proof.
behavior.triage: Shared H3a preparation/quota/dispatch/result and H3b ticket provenance; a completed job is prioritized and recovered without provider or model key; no automatic inference redispatch after uncertainty.
behavior.reconnection: Old incomplete A references rejected with connection_replaced under current B authority, before B private message reads; A reserved quota/history retained; B can progress next invocation. Historical completed/uncertain results retain replay priority.
behavior.receivedDate: Actual message date rechecked before a new reservation and new dispatch against current consent; provider Date is not a verified arrival instant. Prior reservations remain counted if later consent forbids dispatch.
behavior.team: Same scoped shared ticket store; explicit worker attribution; existing fresh assignment/rule requirements retained. Worker cannot correct, assign or close existing tickets.
behavior.browser: Compact projection polling nominally every15 seconds visible/online; exact pending mutation in RAM until matching receipt; GET never acknowledges a POST; identity purge and bounded deadline/body reads.
behavior.audit: Correlated opaque run/organization/workspace identifiers and code/outcome; no subject/body/UID/secret in diagnostic log.
noEffects: mark read or delete upstream message

limits.note: Stop remains possible at consent-version threshold; lifetime run budget can exhaust in about7 days at one run/minute even idle. No90-day service guarantee.

performance.measurement: Real local SQLite adapter/composition statement counts; no hosted latency or provider/model calls.
performance.note: One global minute invocation shares throughput across workspaces; durable fan-out/queue organization and hosted runtime overhead need validation before scale.

chain.workerd: actual statement chunks applied through legacy-country-guard.migrations.test.ts

cli.command: wrangler d1 migrations apply --local --persist-to <isolated local directory>

migration.rollback: Close gate; remove any separately approved cron; restore previous application code; retain immutable history/tables. Hosted application and method require explicit approval.

tests.intermediate: First regression interrupted for A→B recovery fix. Subsequent broad run found the account-page missing worker mock and old invalid human binding fixture, and review found standalone Support missing worker prop. Both tests and page integration corrected; final125-file run supersedes previous evidence. Targeted/overlapping tests are not added to3978.
